structured.feedback: The description is about 170 words in Markdown with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. Its claims come from the listing and reviews, and it leaves out the thickness, cutting-difficulty and lasting-24-hours complaints, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are the loose feature/benefit split, a somewhat generic benefits section, and a "Trusted by Shoppers" section that leans on the rating and price.
